goals: Preserve the accepted C7 shift-click and incoming-item routing behavior for Minecraft Java 26.2 without changing priorities, while adding only the missing standalone custom-ground-pickup audio fallback in C8.
Retain composable coexistence with Carried Container Auto-Routing and the accepted safeguards for exact remainders, live source stacks, Inventory Extended sizing, and foreign-slot exclusion.
scope: Without Carried Container Auto-Routing, preserve the standalone ground-pickup and external QUICK_MOVE order: matching selected main hand, matching occupied physical hotbar, matching occupied offhand, empty physical hotbar, then remaining ordinary inventory. C8 compares the actual incoming count around that unchanged ground-pickup call and sends one collector-only normal vanilla-style local pickup sound only if custom movement occurred and vanilla Player.take did not.

When Carried is loaded, preserve Offhand's single-delegation compatibility seam: yield ground pickup to Carried and delegate external/player-origin QUICK_MOVE through Carried's public API, while the counterpart owns its full carrier and ordinary-inventory hierarchy and the menu receives the exact player-origin remainder.

Keep standalone ordinary routing limited to the player's real non-equipment Inventory slots, require component-identical merges, exclude the clicked source, and retain menu-owned cleanup and callbacks.

exclusions: Shift-click priority changes, new routing tiers, features, configuration, commands, keybinds, GUI, assets, or unrelated inventory behavior.
Source, controls, artifacts, or behavior owned by Carried Container Auto-Routing, Inventory Extended, Trinkets, or any other inventory project.
Routing into equipment, Trinkets, trash, or foreign slots, and replacement of menu-owned cleanup, callbacks, or ordinary destination behavior.
Standalone or exhaustive runtime claims beyond the preserved focused paired C7 plus Carried 0.3.4 evidence.

Runtime deployment, Minecraft launch, accepted-baseline changes, Test Slot changes, Test Instance Manager changes, fake take-item packets, or access to either physical gameplay profile during this successor.
